findings.title: Resolved worktree path is not constrained to the repository
findings.requirement: Work Item 1.1 and FD acceptance require repository-internal path validation and diagnostics for invalid sources.
findings.detail: workspace_info compares resolved metadata and expected paths and checks Git registration, but does not require the resolved expected_worktree to remain beneath the primary repository. An external redirect can therefore be reported as a verified workspace when metadata and Git registration agree. The evidence scanner's later containment check does not correct fd show's status summary.
findings.recommendation: Require the resolved worktree path to remain beneath the resolved primary repository root before returning workspace metadata; report and skip paths that escape it.

findings.title: FD Sources overstates stable spec changes
findings.requirement: FD records and reports should accurately describe the reviewed change set.
findings.detail: The FD says it updated the stable FD workflow spec, but openspec/specs/fd-workflow/spec.md is unchanged from develop and already contains the relevant requirement.
findings.recommendation: Remove the claim that this FD updated the stable spec, or document a required specification change if one is intended.
